Build BattleLIVE · students play on their phones

Game time:

Students scan the QR code of their team, type a nickname and wait. When you press Start, everyone answers picture questions on their phone until the time runs out. The first round goes step by step from the excavation pit to the roof, then questions repeat in a new order. Correct answer: +100. Sometimes a golden ×2 question appears: answer it right and the player's points double. The team with more points wins the cup.

This file is opened from your computer, so phones can't reach it. Upload it to a website first (for example Netlify Drop or GitHub Pages) and open that web address on the classroom computer. Then the QR codes will work.
